raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
The humming MoE backend expects per-block weight scales installed prior to format conversion, causing a KeyError: 'weight_scale' during online MXFP8 setup. Rather than rejecting the backend, this introduces `convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format` in `oracle/mxfp8.py` to register the scale tensors and execute the Humming schema transformation directly.

Fixes #62136

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MXFP8 MoE backend selection and kernel format conversion tests."""
+
+import dataclasses
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from tests.kernels.moe.utils import make_dummy_moe_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.fp8 import Fp8MoeBackend
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp8 import (
+    convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format,
+    select_mxfp8_moe_backend,
+)
+
+
+def test_humming_selected_for_mxfp8():
+    cfg = make_dummy_moe_config(num_experts=8, hidden_dim=256)
+    cfg = dataclasses.replace(cfg, moe_backend="humming")
+
+    sentinel_cls = object()
+    with patch(
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp8._select_kernel_cls",
+        return_value=sentinel_cls,
+    ):
+        backend, cls = select_mxfp8_moe_backend(cfg)
+        assert backend == Fp8MoeBackend.HUMMING
+        assert cls is sentinel_cls
+
+
+def test_convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format_humming():
+    layer = MagicMock()
+    w13 = torch.empty((8, 512, 256), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    w2 = torch.empty((8, 256, 256), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    w13_scale = torch.empty((8, 512, 8), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w2_scale = torch.empty((8, 256, 8), dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    layer.w13_weight = w13
+    layer.w2_weight = w2
+    layer.w13_weight_scale = w13_scale
+    layer.w2_weight_scale = w2_scale
+
+    with patch(
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming.convert_to_humming_moe_kernel_format"
+    ) as mock_convert:
+        out_w13, out_w2, out_w13_scale, out_w2_scale = (
+            convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format(
+                backend=Fp8MoeBackend.HUMMING,
+                layer=layer,
+                w13=w13,
+                w2=w2,
+                w13_scale=w13_scale,
+                w2_scale=w2_scale,
+            )
+        )
+        assert mock_convert.called
+        assert out_w13 is w13
+        assert out_w2 is w2
+        assert out_w13_scale is w13_scale
+        assert out_w2_scale is w2_scale
+
+
+def test_convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format_delegates():
+    layer = MagicMock()
+    t = torch.empty(1)
+    with patch(
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.fp8.convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format",
+        return_value=(t, t, t, t),
+    ) as mock_fp8_convert:
+        res = convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format(
+            backend=Fp8MoeBackend.TRITON_MXFP8,
+            layer=layer,
+            w13=t,
+            w2=t,
+            w13_scale=t,
+            w2_scale=t,
+        )
+        assert mock_fp8_convert.called
+        assert res == (t, t, t, t)

@@ -105,6 +112,81 @@ def _select_kernel_cls(
     )
 
 
+def convert_to_mxfp8_moe_kernel_format(
+    backend: Fp8MoeBackend,
+    layer: "RoutedExperts",
+    w13: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+    w13_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    w2_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    w13_input_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    w2_input_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Transform MXFP8 weights and per-block scales to the backend-specific format."""
+    if backend == Fp8MoeBackend.HUMMING:
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.humming import (
+            convert_to_humming_moe_kernel_format,
+        )
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.layer_utils import (
+            replace_parameter,
+        )
+
+        for prefix, weight, scale, input_scale in (
+            ("w13", w13, w13_scale, w13_input_scale),
+            ("w2", w2, w2_scale, w2_input_scale),
+        ):
+            if hasattr(layer, f"{prefix}_weight"):
+                replace_parameter(layer, f"{prefix}_weight", weight)
+            else:
+                layer.register_parameter(
+                    f"{prefix}_weight",
+                    torch.nn.Parameter(weight, requires_grad=False),
+                )
+
+            if hasattr(layer, f"{prefix}_weight_scale"):
+                replace_parameter(layer, f"{prefix}_weight_scale", scale)
+            else:
+                layer.register_parameter(
+                    f"{prefix}_weight_scale",
+                    torch.nn.Parameter(scale, requires_grad=False),
+                )
+
+            if input_scale is not None:
+                if hasattr(layer, f"{prefix}_input_scale"):
+                    replace_parameter(layer, f"{prefix}_input_scale", input_scale)
+                else:
+                    layer.register_parameter(
+                        f"{prefix}_input_scale",
+                        torch.nn.Parameter(input_scale, requires_grad=False),
+                    )
+
+        convert_to_humming_moe_kernel_format(
+            layer, quant_config={"quant_method": "modelopt", "quant_algo": "mxfp8"}
+        )
+        return (
+            layer.w13_weight,
+            layer.w2_weight,
+            layer.w13_weight_scale,
+            layer.w2_weight_scale,
+        )
+
+    # Defer remaining backends (DeepGEMM, Marlin, Aiter) to fp8 conversion logic
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.fp8 import (
+        convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format,
+    )
+
+    return convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format(
+        fp8_backend=backend,
+        layer=layer,
+        w13=w13,
+        w2=w2,
+        w13_scale=w13_scale,
+        w2_scale=w2_scale,
+        w13_input_scale=w13_input_scale,
+        w2_input_scale=w2_input_scale,
+    )
+
+
 def select_mxfp8_moe_backend(
     config: FusedMoEConfig,
 ) -> tuple[Fp8MoeBackend, type[mk.FusedMoEExperts]]:
